payload.summary: Done via PR #19, squash-merged under the standing small-PR authorization after a genuinely adversarial 3-round codex loop. Round 1 (revise): numbered archive names failed the distilled schema — fixed, schema accepts .N suffix, e2e distill test on a real .2.jsonl. Round 2 (revise): codex PROVED the time-based lock steal wrong by pre-seeding a stale lock + 24 writers (43 archives, 38 duplicate ids) — replaced with ownership-safe pid-marker locking: staleness is process liveness not a clock, a steal removes exactly the dead holders marker (claimed locks fail ENOTEMPTY), entry only by winning mkdir + claiming. Round 3: approve NO FINDINGS, codex re-ran its own repro. Also found en route: the lock-free link/unlink protocol leaked duplicates under 24-writer contention (~50%% flaky e2e) — the mkdir lock serializes the sweep. Final: no-clobber collision archiving (.2.jsonl), ownership-safe sweep lock, 7 new tests incl the adversarial e2e. Suite 1171 green. Version 0.1.2, reinstalled.
